questions.text: How many relations on a set of 4 elements are both reflexive and symmetric?
questions.explain: Reflexivity fixes all 4 diagonal pairs. Symmetry means the C(4,2) = 6 unordered off-diagonal pairs are chosen freely, giving 2^6 = 64.

questions.text: A connected undirected graph has an Euler circuit if and only if:
options: Exactly two vertices have odd degree
Every vertex has degree at least 2
questions.explain: A closed walk using every edge exactly once requires every vertex to have even degree. Exactly two odd-degree vertices gives an Euler path but not a circuit.

questions.text: What is the chromatic number of the complete bipartite graph K(3,4)?
questions.explain: Every bipartite graph with at least one edge is 2-colourable: one colour per part. Size of the parts is irrelevant.

questions.text: In how many ways can 10 identical balls be distributed into 4 distinct boxes, allowing empty boxes?
questions.explain: Stars and bars: C(n + k - 1, k - 1) = C(13, 3) = 286.

questions.text: Which formula is logically equivalent to the implication p -> q?
questions.explain: An implication is false only when p is true and q is false, which is exactly the truth table of NOT p OR q. Note q -> p is the converse, not the equivalent.

questions.text: By Lagrange's theorem, what are the possible orders of a subgroup of a group of order 12?
questions.explain: Lagrange's theorem forces the order of any subgroup to divide the order of the group. The converse does not hold in general - a divisor need not have a corresponding subgroup in every group.

questions.text: The set of divisors of 30 ordered by divisibility forms which structure?
options: A poset that is not a lattice
A lattice, with meet as gcd and join as lcm
questions.explain: Any two divisors have a greatest common divisor and least common multiple that are also divisors of 30, so every pair has a meet and a join. It is not a chain since 2 and 3 are incomparable.

questions.text: What is the closed form of a(n) = 5a(n-1) - 6a(n-2) with a(0) = 1 and a(1) = 0?
questions.explain: The characteristic equation x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 gives roots 2 and 3, so a(n) = A x 2^n + B x 3^n. From A + B = 1 and 2A + 3B = 0 we get A = 3 and B = -2.

questions.text: What is the minimum number of people needed in a room to guarantee that at least three of them share the same birth month?
questions.explain: With 12 months, 24 people could give exactly two per month. The 25th person forces some month to hold three, by the generalised pigeonhole principle.
